name: start-check-needs-unscoped-item
description: The human approves one item and gives a check, half of which needs a different backlog item they did not select. mano start must not draft a brief that silently cuts that half into Not This Phase, nor add the item on its own: it names the cancellation item and asks whether to add it to the phase or leave that part of the check for later.
prompt: mano start. Approve "Group presets in the picker" for Phase 1. My check: I open the picker with forty presets and see them under headings, then I cancel an import halfway, restart, and see none of the cancelled run's values.
